ov: About 41 species of pocket gophers, burrowing rodents of North and Central America named for their fur-lined cheek pouches. They spend nearly all their time in their own tunnel systems and are notorious for damaging farms, lawns and gardens.

why.dg: Usually flees, but if cornered it may attack cats and people and can inflict serious bites.

wt: Usually about 200 g; a few species near 1 kg
rg: North and Central America, from Canada through the US and Mexico to Panama and Colombia.
df: Plant roots, shrubs and juicy vegetables such as carrots, lettuce and radishes.
fx: Its cheek pouches reach back to the shoulders and can be turned inside out to empty them.
It uses its short, hairy tail to feel its way when walking backwards through tunnels.
